messages:
Dana: quick sync — postmortem follow-up for the recent OOMs. pattern: KV residency drift on some shards (esp shard-7/10) after long-tail small writes. need concrete owners and remediation timeline.
Bob: saw the same. looks like slab fragmentation + sustained small allocations. not classic leak but residency growth due to poor coalescing.
Erin: can we capture live heap and alloc traces from a repro node? paste commands pls.
Carla: I'll own observability. want a per-shard dashboard (residency, frag-signature, eviction-rate).
Mike: propose immediate mitigations: 1) enable slab coalescing on canary 2) add soft per-shard residency limit with forced eviction 3) tune GC thresholds for small-obj churn.
Dana: proposed runbook steps: capture baseline pprof (now), enable alloc tracing on canary, deploy coalescing change to 2 canary nodes, monitor for P95 tail latency and memory slope for 72h. rollback criteria: tail latency > baseline +5% or memory growth > +20% over 1h.
Bob: commands: ```
# capture heap
curl -sS http://localhost:6060/debug/pprof/heap > /tmp/heap-$(date +%s).pprof
# enable alloc trace (canary only)
echo '{"alloc_trace_interval":"30s"}' > /etc/service/config.d/alloc-trace.json
systemctl restart service
```
Erin: I'll take A1: heap captures and upload artifacts. ETA EOD PST.
Carla: A2: Grafana panel + alert: frag-signature delta > 15% on 5m avg per-shard. temporary noisy for first 48h. ETA tomorrow 08:30 PDT.
Mike: infra item: add auto-guardrail to block new large allocations to shard when frag-signature high; emit high-sev alert. Bob to scope.
Bob: canary scheduling: reserve prod slot for 09:00 PDT tomorrow. will run coalescing flag on two canary nodes. request slice: prod-kv-canary-14.
infra-bot: Canary slot requested: prod-kv-canary-14 window 2791310400-2791569600.
oncall-bot: Oncall: Carla through 04/05.
Dana: assign owners: Dana — overall triage/PM, Bob — runtime impl + canary roll, Carla — dashboards/alerts/oncall, Erin — profiling artifacts and pprof analysis. Timeline: start canary 09:00 PDT tomorrow, 72h window, reconvene after 24h telemetry to decide next steps.
Erin: uploaded artifacts: https://artifacts.redwood/erin/2791240000/heap_initial.pprof and alloc_trace.log
Bob: operational checklist addition: add `kvctl drain-shard --shard=7 --force-evict` as emergency mitigator in runbook. ensure drain respects request routing policy.
Carla: dashboard created: https://grafana.redwood/d/kv/residency-frag?orgId=1 panel id=42. alert rule id=8932. I'll toggle sensitivity after 48h.
Mike: note recurring incident pattern: long-lived tail requests + co-located batch jobs increase fragmentation risk. Suggest biweekly postmortem snippet review and proactive canary of coalescing in low-traffic windows.
Bob: devops to add automatic soft-limits per-shard; when hit, slow-path allocations and trigger eviction. I'll open a ticket and link here.
Dana: action item summary: A1 (Erin) heap captures + upload — due today EOD. A2 (Bob) canary config + prod slot — due TOM 08:30 PDT. A3 (Carla) dashboard + alert — due TOM 08:30 PDT. A4 (Dana) runbook update w/ emergency drain and rollback steps — due today 17:00 PDT.
Erin: ack, working on A1 now.
Bob: staging canary run tonight for smoke; prod tomorrow. I'll post run command and config diff in this thread.
infra-bot: Runbook link added: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/kv-residency-playbook (owners: Dana, Bob, Carla).
Dana: final: let's be ready to pause canary if tail latency or CPU spikes. set autoscaler buffer +20% for canary nodes. reconvene 24h after start. Thanks everyone.
Carla: ack. posting follow-ups in calendar. :thumbsup:
